concept: Iris: The command center for Discord helpers. A highly technical, brutalist, and dense workspace that feels like a developer tool rather than a generic SaaS.

headings.usage: Used for all headings, ticket IDs, logs, and data points to emphasize the technical nature of the app.

body.usage: Used for long-form text, notes, and conversational transcriptions.

rules: Use tracking-tight for large text and tracking-widest for overlines.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
No full-screen gradients. Texture over gloss.
Do not use pure #000000. Base is #050505 (deepest void).
Primary CTA uses the #5865F2 (Discord homage) but keep it limited.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have border-r border-b border-border/40.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none in dark mode. Rely on surface lightness (e.g. #050505 vs #121212) and 1px crisp borders to separate elements.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) over the main background to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Crisp border color shifts (border-white/10 to border-white/40). No muddy hover shadows.

component_customizations.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely subtle rounding (max rounded-sm). High contrast focus states. Use 1px inner borders for depth.
component_customizations.inputs: Flat, background #121212, border-white/10. Focus: border-primary ring-1 ring-primary/30.
component_customizations.cards: DO NOT use standard floating cards. Use 'Cardless' / Border-collapse technical grids.
component_customizations.scrollbars: Custom thin scrollbars. Track: transparent. Thumb: white/10, hover: white/20.

rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-0 for border-collapse).
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch. No jagged bottoms.
Modified F-Pattern: Most critical command (Search Discord ID) at top-left.

app_structure.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar for Navigation (Active Tickets, Archives, Helper Settings).
app_structure.header: Sticky top, solid background (not transparent). Contains User Profile (Discord Auth) and global search.
app_structure.workspace: Main area divided into 3 equal or resizable columns: Transcription (Left), Notes (Center), Vocal Summary (Right).

rules: Avoid long easing curves. Use quick transitions (150ms-200ms ease-out).
Stagger entrance for list items (e.g., Discord chat history logs loading in).
Micro-animations on buttons: scale 0.98 on active.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass APCA / WCAG AA. Secondary text must not fall below 4.5:1 against the dark background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2).

media.strategy: Minimal imagery. Focus on typography, data, and user avatars.

placeholder_command.description: Dashboard blank state / command center tech visual

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this data-heavy internal admin panel to ensure maximum performance and clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not center-align the app container. Use a left-aligned, full-width technical layout.
Use Shadcn UI for inputs, buttons, and dropdowns, but heavily override the styles to match the 'Grid Borders / Technical' aesthetic (remove border-radius, enforce sharp borders).
For the 3-section workspace (Transcription, Note, Vocal), implement a dense, grid-based layout where columns are clearly delineated by vertical borders.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="new-ticket-button"`).
The UI is native JS/React (as requested: 'Je veux du code natif'). Ensure clean, modular components.
Implement the 'New Ticket' component as a command palette or an always-visible top-left widget where the helper enters a Discord ID or Channel ID.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor Icons for precise, technical iconography.
For toasts/notifications (e.g., 'Discord data synced'), use Sonner with dark mode overrides.
Ensure the transcription area resembles a technical log viewer (monospace timestamps, clear visual separation of messages) rather than a bouncy chat app.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it distinct and technical.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid dark grays and blacks with 1px borders.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use proper SVG icon libraries (Phosphor or Lucide).
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
